capabilities: lint vault Markdown files with markdownlint rules
read rules from .markdownlint.jsonc, .json, .yaml, or .yml config files
highlight lint issues in the editor for fixing as you type
extras: Only .markdownlint.jsonc, .json, .yaml, and .yml config formats are supported; other markdownlint config formats are not. Installation via the BRAT beta plugin installer is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Markdown linting, so files across a vault can drift into inconsistent style with nothing flagging the problems.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses the markdownlint library to lint files in your vault.
This plugin supports a subset of files supported by markdownlint-cli2.

summary: Linting plugin that uses the markdownlint library to flag Markdown style and consistency issues in vault files.
